author: bardic-inspiration
name: Quickstep Rapier
summary: A rapier that lets its wielder slip away after a strike.
description: Duelists in the harbor cities swear by its balance, and curse it when it passes to a rival. The guard is shaped like a folded fan.

stats.effect: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a creature with it, you can move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature.
